The implemented ingestion flow, from Flutter upload to server processing and back to the dashboard.
06–10 Follow the arrows back to the client
Pages → section tags → raw splits → enriched chunks → KPI extraction → persistence snapshot → run summary
RAG boundary: chunk preparation is implemented. Embeddings, vector indexing, retrieval and answer generation are next.
